title: Deurali on the way to Annapurna Base Camp
summary:
ⓘ 1/1900s at f/1.5, ISO 50 
📷 iPhone 13 Pro Max + 5.7mm f/1.5
body:
This photo was taken as we approached Deurali on Day 2 of our Annapurna Base Camp hike. It was one of the longest and toughest days of the trek, with most of the climb happening deep inside a dense forest.

We passed through rainforest-like sections and a couple of waterfalls, but we barely saw any mountains until we got close to Deurali. For most of the day, it didn’t even feel like we were heading toward a mountain base camp - at least not to me.

But everything changed as we neared Deurali. Suddenly, we were surrounded by towering mountains on all sides. We stopped, sat down, and just took it all in. It was the first time I had ever been that close to such high elevation, and it was incredible to watch the landscape change so dramatically - trees fading into shrubs, bare rocky slopes, waterfalls cutting down from the peaks, and the air getting colder with every step. Somewhere along the way, a dog even joined us and guided us through the final stretch of the hike that day. The climb truly took our breath away - literally.

The days that followed were even more magical, and we eventually made it to Annapurna Base Camp the next day. It’s an experience I know will stay with me for years.
